shortDescription: Manages Signature Sets on an ASM policy

options.name: alarm
options.description: Specifies if the security policy logs the request data in the Statistics screen when a request matches a signature that is included in the signature set.

options.name: block
options.description: Effective when the security policy enforcement mode is Blocking. Determines how the system treats requests that match a signature included in the signature set. When C(true), the system blocks all requests that match a signature, and provides the client with a support ID number. When C(false), the system accepts those requests.

options.name: learn
options.description: Specifies if the security policy learns all requests that match a signature that is included in the signature set.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the signature sets to apply to, or remove from, the ASM policy. Apart from built-in signature sets that ship with the device, you can create and use custom signature sets. When C(All Response Signatures), configures all signatures in the attack signature pool that can review responses. When C(All Signatures), configures all attack signatures in the attack signature pool. When C(Apache Struts Signatures), configures signatures that target attacks against the Apache Struts we

options.name: partition
options.description: This parameter is only used when identifying an ASM policy.

options.name: policy_name
options.description: Specifies the name of an existing ASM policy to add or remove signature sets to.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.
